== Description ==
'''LAPSE-200''' is one of the many Lapse Entities you may encounter, it being the Lapse variant of [[SHA-200]], also being the rarest entity in the entire game, having a 1 in 600000 chance to spawn

== Behavior ==
* Will spawn with a loud wind sound, Aimscripting to the player at fast speeds after the words "<span style="text-shadow: 0 O 5px #6A0908; color: #6A0908;">Something wicked this way comes.</span>" appears. if the player is in a locker when '''LAPSE-200''' reaches them, they will start a minigame similar to its shadow counterpart [[SHA-200]], but WAY harder. unlike [[SHA-200]]'s minigame, '''LAPSE-200''''s minigame will go through many Phases, similar to the now removed Harbinger minigame from pressure.

* These are the known phases of '''LAPSE-200''':
** Phase 1: same as [[Player Controlled#Striketeam_Solstice|Striketeam Solstice's]] minigame, occasionally hitting twice at once.
** Phase 2: same as [[SHA-200]]'s minigame (FOV darkens and focuses on your cursor).
** Phase 3: the circle shrinks instead of just moving.
** Phase 4: a red circle is added. The red circle drains your energy faster.
** Phase 5: another red circle is added.
** Phase 6: the last red circle is added. (total = 3)
** Phase 7: randmonly blinds you but also reduces your drain time to 1/3 of it.
** Phase 8: Your healthbar goes completely invisible.

== Strategies & Tips ==
* Pray. This is all you can do.
